Ryan’s Mammoth Collection tune index

A searchable index of the 1045 tunes in William Bradbury Ryan’s Mammoth Collection (Boston, 1883) — reels, jigs, hornpipes, clogs, strathspeys and walkarounds played in 19th-century America, reissued in 1940 as Cole’s 1000 Fiddle Tunes and still known as “the fiddler’s bible”. Open any tune for the book’s own setting with playback.

639 tunes link to their page on thesession.org, where many go by other names — those are shown under the title.
